Package io.jans.core.cedarling.service.policy

Interface PolicyStoreFileProvider

public interface PolicyStoreFileProvider
SPI for managing the policy store file on the local filesystem.

The application embedding CedarlingAuthorizationService must supply a CDI bean that implements this interface. The service calls the methods in the following order during its lifecycle:

  1. prepare() – called once before Cedarling is initialised; the implementation should write (or extract) the policy store file to a well-known location on disk.
  2. getPolicyStorePath() – called immediately after prepare() to obtain the absolute path of the file that was placed on disk.
  3. cleanup() – called once when the Cedarling service is destroyed; the implementation should remove the policy store file from disk.

    • prepare

      void prepare()
      Prepares the policy store file on the local filesystem. This method is called before Cedarling is initialised.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the file cannot be prepared

    • getPolicyStorePath

      String getPolicyStorePath()
      Returns the absolute path of the policy store file on the local filesystem. prepare() is guaranteed to have been called before this method.
      Returns:
      absolute path to the policy store file; never null

    • cleanup

      void cleanup()
      Removes the policy store file from the local filesystem. This method is called after the Cedarling adapter has been closed.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - if the file cannot be removed
